name: Waldorf Astoria Monarch Beach
positioning: Waldorf Astoria resort in Dana Point, California, with a private beach club for registered guests and members
best_for: Families who want a dedicated family pool and a kids club
Travelers who want a private beach club and golf at the resort

facts.text: The hotel was built in 2001 and operated for many years as a St. Regis resort.
In early 2021 the resort joined the Waldorf Astoria Collection.
The resort's golf course was designed by Robert Trent Jones, Jr.
Monarch Bay Beach Club has an indoor-outdoor bar and offers sunset dinners on the Beach Lawn.
AVEO Table + Bar has a rotating seasonal menu with ingredients predominantly grown or caught in Southern California.
Bourbon Steak's cocktail program pairs classic 20th-century cocktails with modern-day interpretations.
33 North is the resort's coastal-inspired living room, with a bar, a fireplace and an outdoor terrace.
Sombra Cantina is a poolside cantina serving fish tacos, salads and ceviche.
Part + Parcel Market offers market-fresh foods, curated picnic baskets, fresh juices, smoothies and La Colombe coffee.
There are two pools, one dedicated to families.
Several ground-floor rooms have patios leading out to the pool area.
Bathrooms have Salvatore Ferragamo toiletries, a soaking tub and dual marble vanities.

highlights.text: The private Monarch Bay Beach Club is exclusive to registered guests and members.
Guests can ride a little tram down to the private Monarch Bay Beach Club.
Bourbon Steak Orange County is Chef Michael Mina's take on the American steakhouse.
The Monarch Beach Kids Club is open to children ages 5 to 12.

considerations.text: The resort sits about a half mile back from the beach.
The resort charges a daily resort fee.
WhataHotel notes that the large resort property may require walking between amenities.
